disclaimer: Regulation data is modeled on Egypt's business registration framework for demonstration purposes only. Fees are approximate and vary by governorate and over time. This is not legal advice.

regulations.title: Mobile Food Vendor (عربة طعام متنقلة)

permits.name: Tax Card (البطاقة الضريبية) - Egyptian Tax Authority
Municipal street vending / operating license (رخصة تشغيل من الحي)
Health certificates for food handlers (شهادات صحية)
Vehicle licensing for food use (ترخيص المركبة)

required_documents: Health certificates for all food handlers
Approval of vehicle layout from health inspector
regulations.zoning_restrictions: Operating locations must be approved by the district (الحي). Vending near schools, hospitals, and government buildings is restricted. Cairo and Giza governorates designate specific food truck zones.
regulations.additional_rules: All food handlers must hold valid health certificates renewed annually. Vehicle must pass health inspection. Gas cylinder safety approval required from Civil Defense (الدفاع المدني).

regulations.title: Restaurant and Food Service (مطعم / منشأة غذائية)

permits.name: Operating license under Law 154/2019 (رخصة تشغيل المحل)
Health certificates for all staff (شهادات صحية)

required_documents: Registered lease contract or ownership deed (عقد إيجار موثق)
Premises floor plan approved by the district
Health certificates for all food handlers
Grease trap and ventilation compliance certificate
regulations.zoning_restrictions: Premises must be in commercially licensed buildings. Restaurants in residential buildings require approval from the building's occupants union (اتحاد الشاغلين). Shisha service requires a separate license.
regulations.additional_rules: Subject to periodic inspection by the Health Ministry and the National Food Safety Authority (NFSA). VAT registration mandatory if annual turnover exceeds EGP 500,000. Social insurance registration required for all employees.

regulations.title: Retail Shop (محل تجاري)

permits.name: Operating license under Law 154/2019 (رخصة تشغيل المحل)

required_documents: Registered lease contract or ownership deed (عقد إيجار موثق)
Premises compliance certificate from the district (الحي)
regulations.zoning_restrictions: Shop must be in a commercially designated unit. Law 154/2019 streamlined licensing: low-risk shops can operate with a notification license (إخطار) while the full license is processed.
regulations.additional_rules: VAT registration mandatory if annual turnover exceeds EGP 500,000. Chamber of Commerce membership (الغرفة التجارية) required. Annual license renewal with the district.

regulations.title: Professional Services / Freelance (مكتب استشاري / عمل حر)

permits.name: Commercial Registry entry or freelance tax file (سجل تجاري أو ملف ضريبي)
Professional syndicate membership if regulated (عضوية النقابة)

required_documents: Degree or professional certification (for regulated professions)
Syndicate membership card (كارنيه النقابة) for lawyers, accountants, engineers, doctors
Office lease contract (if operating from an office)
regulations.zoning_restrictions: Home-based freelancing is permitted with a simplified tax file. Client-facing offices in residential buildings require occupants union approval.
regulations.additional_rules: Regulated professions (law, accounting, engineering, medicine) require active syndicate membership. Freelancers can register under the simplified tax regime for small earners. Egypt's 2023+ freelance tax framework offers simplified flat-rate options for income below thresholds.

regulations.title: Construction and Contracting (مقاولات)

permits.name: Egyptian Federation for Construction Contractors registration (الاتحاد المصري لمقاولي التشييد والبناء)

required_documents: Engineer's syndicate membership for technical manager (كارنيه نقابة المهندسين)
regulations.zoning_restrictions: Equipment storage yards require approval from the district and may need industrial zoning. Site work requires building permits per project from the local administrative unit.
regulations.additional_rules: Contractor classification (degrees 1-7) by the Federation determines maximum project size. Social insurance for construction workers is mandatory and inspected. Each project requires a separate building permit (رخصة بناء).

regulations.title: E-Commerce / Online Business (تجارة إلكترونية)

permits.name: VAT registration if turnover > EGP 500,000 (التسجيل في القيمة المضافة)

required_documents: Address proof (home address acceptable for online-only)
Bank account or e-payment provider agreement
regulations.zoning_restrictions: Online-only businesses can register from a home address. Storing commercial inventory at home beyond personal-use scale may require district approval.
regulations.additional_rules: Egypt's e-commerce tax framework requires registration of online sellers; the ETA actively monitors social-media commerce. Consumer Protection Law 181/2018 requires clear return policies and seller identification on the storefront.

regulations.title: Gym and Fitness Facility (صالة رياضية / جيم)

permits.name: Ministry of Youth and Sports license (ترخيص وزارة الشباب والرياضة)
Operating license from the district (رخصة تشغيل)

regulations.zoning_restrictions: Gyms in residential buildings need occupants union approval and noise compliance. Mixed or ladies-only designation must be declared in the license.
regulations.additional_rules: Ministry of Youth and Sports inspects facilities and trainer certifications. Liability insurance recommended. Health certificates required for staff at facilities with juice bars or cafes.

regulations.title: Nursery / Daycare (حضانة)

permits.name: Ministry of Social Solidarity nursery license (ترخيص وزارة التضامن الاجتماعي)

required_documents: National ID of the license holder (بطاقة الرقم القومي)
Criminal record certificates for ALL staff (فيش وتشبيه لجميع العاملين)
Qualifications of the nursery director (مديرة الحضانة)
regulations.zoning_restrictions: Ground-floor premises with outdoor space strongly preferred; upper floors face stricter approval. Must meet Ministry of Social Solidarity space and safety standards per child.
regulations.additional_rules: Nurseries are licensed and inspected by the Ministry of Social Solidarity under the Child Law. Director must meet qualification requirements (education degree or equivalent). Staff-to-child ratios and periodic inspections are mandatory. ENHANCED REVIEW APPLIES.

regulations.title: Pharmacy (صيدلية)

permits.name: Ministry of Health pharmacy license (ترخيص وزارة الصحة)

required_documents: Pharmacy degree and syndicate membership of the licensed pharmacist (بكالوريوس صيدلة + عضوية النقابة)
Premises plan meeting Ministry of Health specifications
Distance compliance certificate (minimum distance from existing pharmacies)
regulations.zoning_restrictions: Egyptian law enforces a minimum distance between pharmacies (per Pharmacy Practice Law 127/1955 and amendments). Premises must meet Ministry of Health area and storage specifications including refrigeration.
regulations.additional_rules: Only licensed pharmacists may own and operate pharmacies. A pharmacist must be present during all operating hours. Controlled substances require a separate ledger and EDA (Egyptian Drug Authority) compliance. ENHANCED REVIEW APPLIES.

regulations.title: Import / Export Company (استيراد وتصدير)

permits.name: Commercial Registry entry - company form required (السجل التجاري)
Tax Card + VAT registration (البطاقة الضريبية والقيمة المضافة)

required_documents: Commercial registry extract showing import/export activity
Minimum capital proof (Importers Registry requires significant declared capital)
regulations.zoning_restrictions: Registered office required; warehouses require separate licensing from the district and Civil Defense.
regulations.additional_rules: Importers Registry (per Law 121/1982 and amendments) imposes capital and Egyptian-ownership requirements. GOEIC (General Organization for Export and Import Control) handles inspection. Customs registration via Nafeza single-window platform is mandatory. ENHANCED REVIEW APPLIES.

all_businesses: Commercial Registry entry (السجل التجاري) via GAFI or the Chamber of Commerce
Tax Card (البطاقة الضريبية) from the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA)
VAT registration mandatory if annual turnover exceeds EGP 500,000 (standard rate 14%)
Social insurance employer registration (التأمينات الاجتماعية) required when hiring employees
Chamber of Commerce membership (الغرفة التجارية) for commercial activities
E-invoicing enrollment with the ETA for registered businesses
general_requirements.fee_notes: Fees are approximate, in Egyptian pounds (EGP), and vary by governorate, declared capital, and over time. Commercial registry annual subscription is approximately 0.002% of declared capital (min EGP 24, max EGP 2,000).
general_requirements.processing_note: Processing times are estimates. Law 154/2019 introduced streamlined notification-based licensing (إخطار) for low-risk activities.
